      • \n\t
    • ప్రొజెక్షన్ కోణం తప్పించుకునే వేగంపై ప్రభావం చూపదు.
      • \n\t

      पर्याय क्र. 4 आपल्या सूर्यमालेत शुक्राचा निस्तार वेग सर्वात कमी आहे हे योग्य उत्तर आहे.

      \n\n

       Key Points

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • बृहस्पतिचा निस्तार वेग 59.5 किमी/से सह सौरमालेतील सर्वात जास्त आहे. त्यामुळे विधान 1 बरोबर आहे
        • \n\t
      • पृथ्वीचा निस्तार वेग 11.19 (11.2) किमी/से आहे. त्यामुळे विधान 2 बरोबर आहे
        • \n\t
      • निस्तार वेग आकाशीय पदार्थाच्या वस्तुमान आणि त्रिज्येवर अवलंबून असतो. त्यामुळे विधान 3 बरोबर आहे
        • \n\t
      •  बुधाचा निस्तार वेग 4.25 किमी/से सर्वात कमी आहे तर शुक्राचा  निस्तार वेग 10.36 किमी/से आहे. त्यामुळे विधान 4 बरोबर नाही.
        • \n
      \n\n

      Important Points

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • मुख्य भागाच्या गुरुत्वाकर्षण खेचण्यापासून निस्तारासाठी मुक्त, चालविरहित वस्तूने ज्या किमान गतीने हालचाल करणे आवश्यक आहे त्याला निस्तार वेग असे म्हणतात.
        • \n\t
      • एखाद्या वस्तूची एकूण गतीज उर्जा आणि तिची गुरुत्वाकर्षण संभाव्य उर्जा शून्याच्या बरोबरीची असते त्याला निस्तार वेग असे म्हणतात.
        • \n\t
      • निस्तार वेगाचे सूत्र पुढीलप्रमाणे:
        • \n
      \n\n

                                                     \\(V = \\sqrt 2gR\\)

      \n\n

      येथे g हा गुरुत्वाकर्षणामुळे होणारा प्रवेग आहे आणि R ही ग्रहाची त्रिज्या आहे

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • ही अभिव्यक्ती ऊर्जा संवर्धनातून उद्भवते आणि शरीर ज्या दिशेने फेकले किंवा प्रक्षेपित केले जाते त्यापासून स्वतंत्र आहे.
        • \n\t
      • प्रक्षेपणाच्या कोनाचा निस्तार वेगावर कोणताही परिणाम होत नाही.
        • \n\t
      • तर, निस्तार वेग 11 किमी/सेकंद इतकाच राहतो.
        • \n

      সঠিক উত্তর হল বিকল্প 4, অর্থাৎ বুধের মুক্তিবেগ সবচেয়ে কম।

      \n\n

      Key Points

      \n\n
        \n\t
      • বৃহস্পতির মুক্তিবেগ সৌরজগতে সর্বোচ্চ 59.5 কিমি/সেকেন্ড। সুতরাং, বিবৃতি 1 সঠিক।
        • \n\t
      • পৃথিবীর মুক্তিবেগ হল 11.19 (11.2) কিমি/সেকেন্ড। সুতরাং, বিবৃতি 2 সঠিক।
        • \n\t
      • মুক্তিবেগ মহাজাগতিক বস্তুর ভর এবং ব্যাসার্ধের উপর নির্ভর করে। সুতরাং, বিবৃতি 3 সঠিক।

        সঠিক উত্তর হল বিকল্প 4, অর্থাৎ বুধের মুক্তিবেগ সবচেয়ে কম।

        \n\n

        Key Points

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • বৃহস্পতির মুক্তিবেগ সৌরজগতে সর্বোচ্চ 59.5 কিমি/সেকেন্ড। সুতরাং, বিবৃতি 1 সঠিক।
          • \n\t
        • পৃথিবীর মুক্তিবেগ হল 11.19 (11.2) কিমি/সেকেন্ড। সুতরাং, বিবৃতি 2 সঠিক।
          • \n\t
        • মুক্তিবেগ মহাজাগতিক বস্তুর ভর এবং ব্যাসার্ধের উপর নির্ভর করে। সুতরাং, বিবৃতি 3 সঠিক।
          • \n\t
        • বুধের মুক্তিবেগ 4.25 কিমি/সেকেন্ডের সাথে সর্বনিম্ন যেখানে শুক্রের 10.36 কিমি/সেকেন্ডের মুক্তিবেগ রয়েছে। সুতরাং, বিবৃতি 4 সঠিক নয়।
          • \n
        \n\n

        Important Points

        \n\n
          \n\t
        • একটি প্রধান শরীরের মহাকর্ষীয় টান এড়াতে একটি মুক্ত, চালিত বস্তুকে যে ন্যূনতম গতিতে চলতে হবে তাকে মুক্তিবেগ বা মুক্তিগতি বলা হয়।
          • \n\t
        • যে গতিতে একটি বস্তুর মোট গতিশক্তি এবং এর মহাকর্ষীয় স্থিতিশক্তি শূন্যের সমান হয় তাকে মুক্তিবেগ বলা হয়।
          • \n\t
        • মুক্তিবেগের সূত্র হল: \\(V = \\sqrt 2gR\\)
          \n\tযেখানে g হল মহাকর্ষজ ত্বরণ এবং R হল গ্রহের ব্যাসার্ধ।
          • \n\t

          • \n\t

          • \n\t
        • সুতরাং, মুক্তিবেগ 11 কিমি/সেকেন্ডে একই থাকে।

              \nKey Points

              \n\n
                \n\t
              • The rule for changing this sentence from Active voice to Passive voice:\n\t
                  \n\t\t
                • The sentence is in active voice, with the subject "you" performing the action of submitting the important documents.
                  • \n\t\t
                • Interchange the object and subject with each other, i.e. object of the active sentence becomes the subject of the passive sentence.​
                  • \n\t\t
                • To convert it to passive voice, we need to make the object (the important documents) the subject of the sentence and use a form of the verb "to be" with the past participle of the main verb (submitted).
                  • \n\t\t
                • The modal verb "must" remains the same in the passive voice. .
                  • \n\t\t
                • Structure:\n\t\t
                    \n\t\t\t
                  • Subject + must have + V3 + Object (Active Voice)
                    • \n\t\t\t
                  • Object + must have + been + V3 + by + Subject (Passive Voice)
                    • \n\t\t
                  \n\t\t
                  • \n\t\t
                • Example:\n\t\t
                    \n\t\t\t
                  • Disha must have arranged the things. (Active Voice)
                    • \n\t\t\t
                  • The things must have been arranged by Disha. (Passive Voice)
                    • \n\t\t
                  \n\t\t
                  • \n\t
                \n\t
                • \n\t
              • Therefore, the​ correct answer is Option 1.
                \n\t 
                • \n
              \n\n

              ​​Correct sentence: The important documents must have been submitted by you.

                  The correct answer is "I requested Sharma to give me his book."Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

                  \n\n

                  I said to Sharma, “Please give me your book”.

                  \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "I request Sharma please give me your book."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "I requested Sharma to give me his book."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "I requested Sharma to give your book."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "I requested Sharma book."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                  The correct answer is "I requested Sharma to give me his book."

                  \n\n

                  Key Points 

                  \n\n
                    \n\t
                  • Indirect speech requires a change in tense and pronouns.
                    • \n\t
                  • The reporting verb 'said/said to' is changed to 'requested' to reflect a polite request.
                    • \n\t
                  • The first person in the reported speech changes according to the subject of the reporting speech.
                    • \n\t
                  • In Reported Speech change of the second person depends on the object of reporting speech.
                    • \n\t
                  • The third person remains unchanged.
                    • \n\t
                  • Imperative sentences do not normally have an expressed subject.
                    • \n\t
                  • This is because the subject ‘you’ is usually understood.
                    • \n\t
                  • As a result of this, imperative sentences begin with a verb in the simple present tense.
                    • \n\t
                  • In order to change an imperative sentence into indirect speech, we use a to-infinitive.
                    • \n\t
                  • Example: \n\t
                      \n\t\t
                    • The old woman said to the boy, ‘Please help me.’
                      • \n\t\t
                    • The old woman requested the boy to help her.
                      • \n\t
                    \n\t
                    • \n\t
                  • Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.
                    \n\t 
                    • \n
                  \n\n

                  Correct sentence: I requested Sharma to give me his book.

                  Key Points

                    • \n\t
                  • The rules of Direct and Indirect speech for negative sentence conversions.\n\t

                            \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "He was paid by the employer salary."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "He was being paid the salary by the employer."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "The salary was paid to him by the employer."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "He had been paid the salary by the employer."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "3", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                            The correct answer is "The salary was paid to him by the employer."

                            \n\n

                            Key Points 

                            \n\n
                              \n\t
                            • The given sentence is in Active Voice. As per the given question, we have to change it to Passive Voice. 
                              • \n\t
                            • The structure of the given sentence is as follows:\n\t
                                \n\t\t
                              • Subject + V2 + Object. (Active Voice)
                                • \n\t\t
                              • Subject (objective case)+ was/were + V3 + Object (subjective case). (Passive Voice)
                                • \n\t\t
                              • Example:\n\t\t
                                  \n\t\t\t
                                • Their cousin showed them some rare photographs. (Active Voice)
                                  • \n\t\t\t
                                • They were shown some rare photographs by their cousin. (Passive Voice)
                                  • \n\t\t
                                \n\t\t
                                • \n\t
                              \n\t
                              • \n\t
                            • The subject of the given sentence is 'employer'.​​
                              • \n\t
                            • The object of the given sentence is 'salary'. 
                              • \n\t
                            • The subject will be put in place of the object and the object will be put in place of the subject.
                              • \n\t
                            • The verb "paid" becomes "was paid" in the passive voice, and the doer of the action (employer) becomes the object of the preposition "by". 
                              • \n\t
                            • The correct answer is Option 3.
                              \n\t 
                              • \n
                            \n\n

                            Correct Sentence: The salary was paid to him by the employer.

                            Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom.

                            \n\n

                            Go through fire and water

                            \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "To pass through life"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "To pass through all types of hardships"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "To pass through all types of luxury"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "To fail in all types of hardships"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                            The correct answer is "To pass through all types of hardships."

                            \n\n

                            Key Points

                            \n\n
                              \n\t
                            • An idiom is a group of words, or in other words, a phrase that has a meaning different from the literal meaning of the words in it. \n\t
                                \n\t\t
                              • Example: "Under the weather" means feeling ill or getting a cold.
                                • \n\t
                              \n\t
                              • \n\t
                            • The idiom 'go through fire and water' means to face and overcome all types of hardships or difficulties.
                              • \n\t
                            • सभी प्रकार की कठिनाइयों या कठिनाइयों का सामना करना और उनसे पार पाना |
                              • \n\t
                            • The phrase is often used to describe someone who has gone through a lot of challenges and struggles but has come out stronger on the other side.\n\t
                                \n\t\t
                              • Example: I will go through fire and water for you. 
                                • \n\t
                              \n\t
                              • \n
                            \n\n

                            Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

                            \n\n

                            Additional Information

                            \n\n
                              \n\t
                            • Option 1: 'To pass through life' is not the correct meaning of the idiom. It is a literal interpretation that does not capture the figurative sense of the phrase.
                              • \n\t
                            • Option 3: 'To pass through all types of luxury' is the opposite of the intended meaning of the idiom. The phrase is about overcoming hardships, not enjoying luxury.
                              • \n\t
                            • Option 4: 'To fail in all types of hardships' is also the opposite of the intended meaning. The idiom is about overcoming challenges, not succumbing to them.  
                              • \n

                            Select the word that is OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.

                            \n\n

                            On several occasions he defended the cause of moderation and justice against the fanatical crusaders.

                            \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "Liberal"}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "Generous"}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "Profound"}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "Intolerant"}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "1", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                            The correct answer is "Liberal."

                            \n\n

                            Key Points

                            \n\n
                              \n\t
                            • Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words: \n\t
                                \n\t\t
                              • The word "fanatical" in the sentence suggests extremism or intolerance.(कट्टर)\n\n\t\t
                                  \n\t\t\t
                                • ​Example: Many have suffered at the hands of the fanatical few.
                                  • \n\t\t
                                \n\t\t
                                • \n\t
                              \n\t
                              • \n\t
                            • The opposite of extremism or intolerance is moderation or liberalism.\n\t
                                \n\t\t
                              • "Liberal" is an adjective that describes someone who is open to new ideas and tolerant of different opinions.(उदार)\n\t\t
                                  \n\t\t\t
                                • ​Example: He has a very liberal view on religion.
                                  • \n\t\t
                                \n\t\t
                                • \n\t
                              \n\t
                              • \n\t
                            • In the given sentence, the person defended the cause of moderation and justice against the fanatical crusaders, implying that he was against extremism and in favor of liberalism.
                              • \n\t
                            • Therefore, the word that is opposite in meaning to "fanatical" is "liberal".
                              • \n
                            \n\n

                            ​Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

                            \n\n

                            Additional Information

                            \n\n
                              \n\t
                            • Option 2 (Generous) means someone who is giving or willing to give more than is necessary or expected, which is not opposite to "fanatical".(उदार)
                              • \n\t
                            • Option 3 (Profound) means having great depth or seriousness, which is not opposite to "fanatical".(गहरा)
                              • \n\t
                            • Option 4 (Intolerant) means not willing to accept beliefs, opinions, or behaviors that differ from one's own, which is synonymous with "fanatical".(असहिष्णु)
                              • \n

                                Select the option that expresses the given sentence in future tense form.

                                \n\n

                                A signboard was hanging there for the travellers indicating the directions.

                                \n", "options": [{"prompt": "1", "value": "A signboard had hung there for the travellers indicating the directions."}, {"prompt": "2", "value": "A signboard will be hanging there for the travellers indicating the directions."}, {"prompt": "3", "value": "A signboard has been hanging there for the travellers indicating the directions."}, {"prompt": "4", "value": "A signboard is found hanging there for the travellers indicating the directions."}], "range": {"start": "", "end": ""}}}, "correct_option": "2", "solution_html": {"en": "\n

                                The correct answer is "A signboard will be hanging there for the travellers indicating the directions."

                                \n\n

                                Key Points

                                \n\n
                                  \n\t
                                • The sentence is in past tense ("A signboard was hanging there").
                                  • \n\t
                                • So to express it in future tense we need to use the future form  i.e. "will be hanging."
                                  • \n\t
                                • "Will" is the auxiliary verb used to form the future tense in English.
                                  • \n\t
                                • "Be" is the auxiliary verb used to form the passive voice in English, which is needed here because the subject of the sentence is the signboard, not the travellers.
                                  • \n\t
                                • The main verb "hang" remains in its base form because it is preceded by the auxiliary verbs "will" and "be."
                                  • \n\t
                                • Thus, the sentence in future form will be :\n\t
                                    \n\t\t
                                  • A signboard will be hanging there for the travellers indicating the directions.
                                    • \n\t
                                  \n\t
                                  • \n
                                \n\n

                                ​​Hence, the correct answer is option 2.

                                \n\n

                                Additional Information

                                \n\n
                                  \n\t
                                • Option 1 ("A signboard had hung there") expresses the past perfect tense, which indicates an action that was completed before another past action.
                                  • \n\t
                                • Option 3 ("A signboard has been hanging there") expresses the present perfect continuous tense, which indicates an ongoing action that started in the past and continues up to the present. 
                                  • \n\t
                                • Option 4 ("A signboard is found hanging there") uses the present tense.
                                  • \n

                                Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.

                                The correct answer is "The teacher told me that I had not followed her instructions properly."

                                \n\n

                                \n\n
                                  \n\t
                                • The reported speech in indirect speech requires changes in tense and pronouns.
                                  • \n\t

                                  • \n\t
                                • The use of "had" indicates past tense.
                                  • \n\t
                                • The pronoun "you" changes to "I" as the speaker is reporting what was said to them.
                                  • \n\t
                                • Thus, the sentence in indirect speech will become:\n\t
                                    \n\t\t
                                  • The teacher told me that I had not followed her instructions properly.
                                    • \n\t
                                  \n\t
                                  • \n
                                \n\n

                                  • \n\t
                                • Option 4: Incorrect. The tense is incorrect as it uses "have" instead of "had" and does not accurately reflect the past tense of the original sentence.
                                  • \n

                                  • \n\t

                                  • \n\t
                                • Option 4, "I offered Hia to not litter" is incorrect as the original sentence does not involve an offer. 
                                  • \n

                                  • \n\t
